high_level_description: stc brand style, two women walking through a bright, modern shopping mall carrying colorful shopping bags.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A modern shopping mall with a curved white glass and steel dome ceiling in a geometric pattern, polished white flooring, glass railings on the upper level, small potted plants near storefronts, and multiple retail stores.

elements.desc: A woman wearing a black long-sleeved dress, walking through the mall.
A woman wearing a brown abaya and black hijab, walking beside her, both carrying pink and purple shopping bags.
A retail store visible in the background with its brand name displayed above the storefront.
